versions.content: The Default Error Tracer shall provide an interface to receive runtime error reports Type: Valid Description: The Default Error Tracer shall provide an interface to get a runtime error report, issued by BSW modules. The Default Error Tracer returns to the caller in order to allow continuation of intended program flow. Rationale: An interface will be needed to enable handling of runtime errors, caused by seldom occurring systematic faults. The caller will handle the error and continue appropriate in a deterministic manner. Use Case: CANNM_E_NET_START_IND: Reception of NM PDUs in Bus-Sleep Mode AppliesTo: CP Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
